messages.subject: Frasers Property Thailand | Sustainable real estate, partnerships and stakeholder leadership
messages.body:
Dear Frasers Property Thailand Leadership Team,

Frasers Property Thailand's focus on sustainable development and green building standards aligns closely with my experience connecting investment, ESG and stakeholder execution.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate coordination and executive stakeholder strategy.

I manage complex interfaces among public institutions, communities, technical teams and senior leadership. I also support governance around renewable energy, battery storage and carbon-data readiness. This gives me a practical perspective on sustainable development where commitments need to translate into operating evidence and trusted relationships.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand or regional roles across Sustainability, Corporate Affairs, Government Relations, Strategic Partnerships or stakeholder leadership. I have attached a Frasers Property Thailand-focused executive CV for review.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
